mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_runs(trace_id,actor_user_id,status,model_id,attempts,mock,created_at,ended_at,session_id,task_id,ingestion_id,previous_trace_id,incomplete,telemetry_dropped,node_count) VALUES(#{args[0]},#{args[1]},#{args[2]},#{args[3]},#{args[4]},#{args[5]},#{args[6]},#{args[7]},#{args[8]},#{args[9]},#{args[10]},#{args[11]},#{args[12]},#{args[13]},#{args[14]}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status=VALUES(status),model_id=VALUES(model_id),attempts=VALUES(attempts),mock=VALUES(mock),ended_at=VALUES(ended_at),incomplete=VALUES(incomplete),telemetry_dropped=VALUES(telemetry_dropped),node_count=VALUES(node_count)

INSERT INTO ai_spans(trace_id,span_id,parent_span_id,sequence_no,node_type,status,started_at,ended_at,node_json) VALUES (#{row[0]},#{row[1]},#{row[2]},#{row[3]},#{row[4]},#{row[5]},#{row[6]},#{row[7]},#{row[8]}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE span_id=span_id
